findings.title: No Supporting Evidence for Giftor Source of Wealth

source.text: Giftor claims £200,000 from pension and property sale. All 6 evidence items marked 'Not obtained'. Verification decision shows 'Accepted on self-declaration' selected.

reference.text: For gifts exceeding £10,000, self-declaration alone is not sufficient. Documentary evidence of the giftor's source of wealth must be obtained, such as pension statements, bank statements, or property sale completion statements.

findings.deviation: £200,000 gift accepted on self-declaration alone with no supporting documentary evidence. Policy requires documentary evidence for gifts exceeding £10,000.
